args.title: Confirm J302 multiply CLI gap
args.content: What: The pinned J302 contract requires optional `--multiply a b`, while the authorized fixture CLI currently returns `NaN` for both multiply examples and the existing sum check passes. Why: Ground a one-unit planner proposal in observed behavior rather than assuming support exists. Where: Exclusive fixture `/tmp/isswf-e2e61-u76tcs`, checkpoint and target base `74f5cd35a22594102f3fd5eb1815740146219a20`, files `spec.md`, `plan.md`, `.factory/jobs/J302/brief-r1.md`, `.factory/jobs/J301/R001.md`, `.factory/jobs/J301/validation.md`, `sum.mjs`, `cli.mjs`, `check.mjs`. Learned: The input checkpoint and target base have the same full SHA but remain distinct concepts; validation separately confirms factory methodology identity `d5986363551e96710c0aa015a3f3b7969a8cd55e`. The plan is a proposal only, not adopted or implemented.
